name: Jecholiah
title: Mother of King Azariah (Uzziah) of Judah
summary: Jecholiah was a woman from Jerusalem who was the mother of King Azariah (also known as Uzziah), one of the kings of Judah. She is mentioned in 2 Kings and 2 Chronicles as the wife of King Amaziah. Although little is written about her, she played an important role as queen mother in the history of the kingdom of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Azariah's mother
keyEvents.description: Jecholiah is mentioned as the mother of King Azariah (Uzziah) of Judah, and it is stated that she was from Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 2 Chronicles, Jecholiah is again mentioned as the mother of Uzziah, with the information that she was from Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Amaziah's reign and death
keyEvents.description: Jecholiah's husband, King Amaziah, reigned in Jerusalem but was eventually killed in a conspiracy, which led to his son Uzziah becoming king.

keyEvents.title: Uzziah's enthronement as king
keyEvents.description: After his father's death, Uzziah (Azariah), son of Jehoash, was made king over Judah when he was sixteen years old.

keyEvents.title: The Prosperity of Uzziah
keyEvents.description: Uzziah, son of Jehoash, became a powerful king who strengthened Judah militarily and economically, and he sought God in the early years of his reign.
